title: Fewer yet critical: Reducing Redundant Token Dependencies for Transformer-based Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2503.06867v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time series forecasting (TSF) is important in real-world applications. Recently, Transformer-based methods have achieved strong performance by modeling token dependencies through attention mechanisms. However, existing methods are usually trained mainly with prediction error losses, which may cause models to exploit both critical and redundant token dependencies. Such redundant dependencies can introduce irrelevant information and weaken generalization. To address this issue, we propose a simple yet effective token dependency selection strategy. Specifically, by jointly introducing the attention entropy constraint and prediction error constraint, the model can identify fewer but more critical inter-token dependencies and perform forecasting based on them, thus avoiding the interference of redundant dependencies. The proposed method can be easily extended to various Transformer-based TSF models. Experiments on multiple TSF datasets de

translated_title: 少而关键：减少基于Transformer的时间序列预测中的冗余标记依赖
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测（TSF）在现实世界的应用中非常重要。近年来，基于Transformer的方法通过注意力机制对标记（token）依赖进行建模，取得了出色的性能。然而，现有方法通常主要使用预测误差损失进行训练，这可能导致模型同时利用关键的和冗余的标记依赖。这种冗余依赖会引入无关信息并削弱模型的泛化能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种简单而有效的标记依赖选择策略。具体而言，通过联合引入注意力熵约束和预测误差约束，模型能够识别出更少但更关键的标记间依赖，并基于这些依赖进行预测，从而避免冗余依赖的干扰。所提出的方法可以轻松扩展到各种基于Transformer的时间序列预测模型。在多个时间序列预测数据集上的实验表明……（摘要内容不完整）
tldr: 提出一种联合利用注意力熵约束与预测误差约束的标记依赖选择策略，使基于Transformer的时间序列预测模型能够识别更少但更关键的标记间依赖，从而避免冗余依赖的干扰并提升泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple yet effective token dependency selection strategy that jointly applies attention entropy and prediction error constraints, enabling Transformer-based time series forecasting models to exploit fewer but more critical inter-token dependencies while avoiding the interference of redundant ones.
